body:
## Objective

Fixes #63978

When configuring dev container features in `devcontainer.json`, community features often accept array or numeric options (such as package lists: `"packages": ["libsnappy-dev", "libvips-dev", "xauth"]`),  as well as `null` to explicitly clear optional settings.

But currently, `FeatureOptionValue` in `crates/dev_container/src/devcontainer_json.rs` only defined `Bool` and `String` variants. when an array, number, or null  is provided, Serde's untagged enum deserialization fails with `data did not match any variant of untagged enum FeatureOptions`, comingup as an unhandled `DevContainerParseFailed` and aborting container startup.

## Solution/Fix

1. **Extend `FeatureOptionValue`**: Added `Null`, `Number(serde_json::Number)`, `Array(Vec<FeatureOptionValue>)`, and `Object(HashMap<String, FeatureOptionValue>)` variants to `FeatureOptionValue` so all standard JSON option types deserialize cleanly.
2. **Environment Variable Formatting**: Implemented `Display` for `FeatureOptionValue` so values written into `devcontainer-features.env` are properly formatted for feature install scripts:
   - Scalar arrays format as comma-separated values (`libsnappy-dev,libvips-dev,xauth`), which matches what existing feature install scripts expect (e.g. `APT_PACKAGES=("${PACKAGES//,/ }")`).
   - Objects format as compact JSON strings.
   - Numbers and booleans format directly to their string representations.
   - - Null formats as `"null"`.

## Testing

- **Reproduction**: Reproduced the failure first using an isolated test before the fix (confirmed panic on `DevContainerParseFailed`).
- **Unit & Regression Tests**: Added tests in `crates/dev_container/src/devcontainer_json.rs`:
  - `should_deserialize_feature_with_array_number_and_null_options` (verifies array of strings, boolean flags, numeric, and null options together)
  - `should_deserialize_feature_with_empty_array_options` (verifies `[]`)
  - `should_format_feature_option_values_properly` (unit tests `Display` across all 5 variants , including `Null`)
- **Crate Test Suite**: All 119 tests in `crates/dev_container` pass (`cargo test -p dev_container`).
- **Formatting & Linter**: Passed `cargo fmt -p dev_container -- --check`, `.\script\clippy.ps1 -p dev_container`, and `typos`.
- **Reviewer Testing**: Can be verified by running `cargo test -p dev_container --lib should_deserialize_feature_with_array_number_and_null_options`

## Self-Review Checklist:

- [x] I've reviewed my own diff for quality, security, and reliability
- [x] Unsafe blocks (if any) have justifying comments
- [x] The content adheres to Zed's UI standards ([UX/UI](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#uiux-checklist) and [icon](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/main/crates/icons/README.md) guidelines)
- [x] Tests cover the new/changed behavior
- [x] Performance impact has been considered and is acceptable

---

Release Notes:

- Fixed an issue where dev containers failed to start when features had array, numeric or null options.

### 🟡 Changes recommended `null` options remain unsupported, and structured arrays/objects can be formatted incorrectly. *Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview This pull request extends dev container feature options to support numbers, arrays, and objects, with formatting and regression tests. **Changes:** - Adds numeric, array, and object option variants. - Formats values for feature environment variables. - Adds deserialization and formatting tests. - Outstanding findings: unsupported `null` options (critical, 3 votes) and incorrect formatting of nested arrays/objects (moderate, 1 vote).
File summaries | File | Summary | |---|---| | `crates/dev_container/src/devcontainer_json.rs` | Extends feature option types, formatting, and regression tests. |
Review details ### Suppressed comments (4) **crates/dev_container/src/devcontainer_json.rs:140** * `write_feature_env` later emits this value as an unquoted `KEY=value` line and the install wrapper sources that file (`features.rs:178-184`, `devcontainer_manifest.rs:3112-3115`). For an object such as `{"a":"b"}`, shell quote removal turns the JSON into `{a:b}` (and shell expansions in values can execute), so feature scripts do not receive the object represented here. Shell-escape values when writing the env file and add a sourced-env regression test. ``` FeatureOptionValue::Object(map) => { if let Ok(json_str) = serde_json::to_string(map) { write!(f, "{}", json_str) ``` **crates/dev_container/src/devcontainer_json.rs:122** * The `FeatureOptions` documentation immediately above still says option values are limited to strings or booleans, but these new variants also accept numbers, arrays, and objects. Update the contract so it does not contradict the deserializer. ``` Number(serde_json::Number), Array(Vec), Object(HashMap), ``` **crates/dev_container/src/devcontainer_json.rs:2005** * This formatter test does not exercise the newly added `Object` branch, so compact-JSON formatting is not regression-tested despite the test covering the other variants. Add an object value and assert its serialized result. ``` let arr = FeatureOptionValue::Array(vec![ FeatureOptionValue::String("a".to_string()), FeatureOptionValue::String("b".to_string()), ]); assert_eq!(arr.to_string(), "a,b"); ``` **crates/dev_container/src/devcontainer_json.rs:135** * This formatter accepts recursively nested arrays and objects, but joining every item with commas loses their structure: `[ ["a", "b"], ["c"] ]` becomes `a,b,c`, and an array of objects loses its outer brackets. That silently changes valid JSON option values; either restrict this representation to scalar arrays or preserve structured arrays as JSON before passing them to the feature. ``` FeatureOptionValue::Array(items) => { let formatted = items .iter() .map(|item| item.to_string()) .collect::>() .join(","); ``` - **Files reviewed:** 1/1 changed files - **Comments generated:** 1 - **Review effort level:** Lite
